summary: Master data product management, data mesh principles, and data contracts. Build enterprise analytics platforms and scale domain data products. Register today!
lede: Data product management and domain-based analytics operating models help organizations move from centralized report building and pipeline delivery toward domain-owned, production-grade data products. This course shows you how to define clear ownership, quality commitments, discoverable interfaces, service level agreements, and measurable business value for internal data assets. You will practice creating machine-readable data contracts, automated quality testing pipelines, metadata models, access policies, semantic layers, and internal data marketplaces. Using frameworks and platforms including Data Mesh, OpenDataContract specifications, Apache Iceberg, Great Expectations, Monte Carlo, Databricks Unity Catalog, Snowflake Horizon, and dbt, you will develop practical roadmaps and governance blueprints for operating data products.
audienceIntro: This programme is designed for professionals leading the shift toward domain-driven analytics, decentralized data architecture, and data mesh operating models.
modules: Foundations of Data Product Management & Data Mesh
FinOps, Value Tracking, & Data Product Economics
Data Product Strategy, Roadmapping, & Enterprise Adoption
prerequisites: Participants should possess a working knowledge of enterprise data architecture concepts, SQL queries, and basic analytics workflows. No programming or software coding experience in Python or Java is required for course completion. Familiarity with cloud data platforms (such as Snowflake, Databricks, or AWS) and enterprise BI tools is recommended.
